# Deer Fabrics

> Cloth materials traders in Karur, Tamil Nadu, India. Wholesale woven cotton and blended fabrics for bed, kitchen and table linen, supplied by the running metre, roll or bale, with pan-India dispatch by road.

- Address: No. 16, Sengunthapuram 3rd Cross, Karur 639 002, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94432 04792, +91 92458 64205
- GSTIN: 33ANJPA9839K2ZN
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 to 19:00 IST
- Languages: English, Tamil

## Fabrics

- DF-SH-01 Percale sheeting: plain 1/1, 40s × 40s, 110–130 GSM, 90″–120″
- DF-GR-02 Grey / greige (kora): plain 1/1, 30s–60s, 90–160 GSM, 36″–120″
- DF-CB-03 Chambray: indigo warp, white weft, 20s × 20s, 130–160 GSM, 58″–63″
- DF-HB-04 Herringbone drill: broken 2/2 twill, 16s × 12s, 220–280 GSM, 58″–63″
- DF-HC-05 Honeycomb waffle: 2/20s × 10s, 200–260 GSM, 58″–63″
- DF-YD-06 Yarn-dyed check: 20s × 20s, 140–170 GSM, 45″–63″
- DF-CV-07 Cotton canvas: 2/2 basket, 10s × 10s, 280–400 GSM, 58″–72″
- DF-DS-08 Satin-stripe damask: 8-end satin stripe, 40s × 40s, 150–200 GSM, 63″–120″

Finishes: greige, RFD, bleached, dyed, printed. Custom constructions sourced to spec. Export surplus stock traded when available.

Buyers: home-textile exporters, made-up manufacturers, garment and stitching units, wholesalers and retailers, hotels, hospitals and institutions.
